title: How the games are really made: agents, skills, an assembler and a lot of checks
summary: Behind the 1987 studio is a pipeline of AI coding agents, packaged skills, Python scripts, the sjasmplus assembler, a contention-modelled Z80 simulator and a browser emulator. This is how a game goes from an idea to a demo on this site, with real excerpts from the build, verify and gate records, and what has gone wrong.
